FAQS.q: How do I reset my password?
FAQS.a: Go to the login page and click "Forgot password". You will receive a reset link by email. If you do not receive it within a few minutes, check your spam folder or contact support.

FAQS.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
FAQS.a: Log in to your dashboard, go to Billing, and select Cancel Subscription. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period. For billing disputes, contact us directly.

FAQS.q: How do I request a copy of my data?
FAQS.a: Log in to your dashboard, go to Data & Privacy, and submit a Subject Access Request. We will respond within 30 days in line with UK GDPR.

FAQS.q: How do I report a profile?
FAQS.a: Visit the public profile page and click "Report this profile". Select the reason and provide details. Our moderation team reviews all reports.

FAQS.q: I think my account has been compromised. What should I do?
FAQS.a: Change your password immediately from the login page. Then contact us using the form below, selecting "Security concern" as the category. We will prioritise your request.

FAQS.q: Can I use Sousa Murray Profiles if I am outside the UK?
FAQS.a: Account creation, purchasing, and profile management is available to UK-based users aged 18 and over only. Public profiles can be viewed worldwide.
